## blowhorn star

Star GitHub repositories. From every selected profile, over the REST API with no browser: `--platform` github `--repo` owner/repo, repeatable. Already-starred repositories are counted apart, never re-credited. `--dry-run` reads each repository's star state for real and names exactly which would be starred, issuing no PUT. A live run exits 0 only when at least one repository was confirmed and every attempted repository was confirmed by at least one profile. Star cannot be scheduled: it stars only the repositories named on the command line.

```text
blowhorn star [OPTIONS]
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ignore-risk` | boolean | `false` | Run this once even if your Risk Profile would hold it (a daily cap, quiet hours, outreach turned off or a pause after a sign-in challenge). Only this run; your Risk Profile stays as it is. A limit the platform itself publishes still applies |
| `--repo` | string, repeatable |  | GitHub only, repeatable: a repository as owner/name, or a github.com URL for one. At least one is required |
| `--platform` | string |  | Platform scope for `blowhorn star`. One of: github (any other platform, including `all`, is rejected) |
| `--pace` | string |  | Pace of the random delays between `blowhorn star` actions (page loads, typing, clicks, API calls): a preset name (fast/normal/slow) or a numeric multiplier (e.g. 0.5, 2.0). Resolved as CLI flag, then `BLOWHORN_PACE`, then defaults.pace in .blowhorn.yaml (normal when none is set); an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |
| `--risk-profile` | string |  | Risk Profile this run uses: cautious, standard or brisk. For this one run it beats the schedule's value, the profile's choice and configuration. A value after the command word wins over one before it; an unrecognized value is rejected before anything runs |

Also takes the [shared flags](/docs/reference/cli/shared-flags/): `--config`, `--log-dir`, `--profile`, `--exclude`, `--headless`, `--chrome-launch`, `--headed`, `--dry-run`, `--verbose`.

Examples:

```bash
blowhorn star --platform github --profile alex --repo acme/widgets --dry-run
blowhorn star --platform github --profile alex --repo acme/widgets
blowhorn star --platform github --profile all --repo acme/widgets --repo meshery/meshery
blowhorn star --platform github --profile kate,rian --repo acme/widgets
blowhorn star --platform github --profile all --repo acme/widgets --exclude alex
```

Output: text.
